### Review checklist

- [ ] I am authorised to submit these materials and state the provider relationship.
- [ ] All fixtures are fictional and sandbox-only; no real customer information or API secrets are included.
- [ ] Public data/documentation can be shared under the applicable terms.
- [ ] Required form inputs, coverage, deductibles, limits, exclusions and eligibility are documented.
- [ ] Success, no-quote and unavailable fixtures are present.
- [ ] `npm test` and `npm run validate` pass.
- [ ] I understand that merge does not activate the provider or establish a commercial agreement.
